number of healthy participants averaged in the map, from the hc<n> filename token

regional mean of the group-average tracer map (binding measure, see value_unit); hemisphere-specific
Note: measure class differs by map (BPND / VT / Bmax / SUVR) -- never pool across value_unit without z-scoring; 15 significant digits (R write.csv), source tokens have 18

Definition: measure of value: BPND (non-displaceable binding potential, unitless), VT (tracer distribution volume, mL/cm3), Bmax_pmol_mL (density pmol/mL converted from BP or VT using autoradiography), SUVR (standard uptake value ratio, unitless), see_source (not stated in the paper)
Note: from reference_tables/<item>_tracer_units.csv (Table 1 for the 26 main maps; Methods inference for 5HTT_dasb_hc30_savli; 14 maps see_source)

Definition: where value_unit comes from: "Table 1", a Methods inference (spelled out), or "not stated in paper"

one row = one region x hemisphere x group-average tracer map; NOT a species mean and NOT a per-receptor value -- same-receptor maps (5HT1b, D2, mGluR5, VAChT; plus the alternative maps) are kept separate here
Note: Hansen combine same-receptor maps by n-weighted average of z-scored maps (make_receptor_matrix.py); deferred to the consumer

Definition: voxelwise group-average PET maps in MNI152 space averaged within Lausanne scale033 parcels by the authors (code/parcellate.py); region x tracer tabulation taken from the authors' repository at commit f8b41da92a733f99368c1f39d4959731aa1316c1
